verdict.rationale: Datalab is API-first. Every core processing feature has a documented API or SDK equivalent: convert, extract, segment, form filling, track-changes document creation, pipelines, file management, agent processors, schema generation, webhooks and a CLI. Features shown in the Forge playground, such as Track Changes, map to these endpoints. However, there is no explicit statement of API/UI parity. Account functions such as enabling 2FA and team-wide 2FA enforcement are documented only through the dashboard, and no OpenAPI spec could be found. Missing for 10: an explicit parity guarantee, API coverage for account/security/team administration, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
